The main takeaway from our work is that
Tcoupling is not a constant value and can be measured accurately from a tachogram only for a large range of the Tcontact.
, in order to obtain accurate values of Tcoupling from a tachogram and a force platform recording, Tcontact should be longer than about 800 ms.
, when Tcontact is longer than 850 ms, it is possible to estimate Tcoupling from Tcontact, thus reducing the number of measurements to be made.
